key_insight: A modular, hard-constrained learning framework produces a compact turbulence closure while enforcing boundary values and realizability by construction.
engineering_relevance: The deployed 18-parameter closure uses only the Taylor-scale Reynolds number and can be exported as a standalone C function for solver integration.
method: Couple closure and DeepONet state networks through governing-equation residuals, without reference closure labels.
Learn monotone input coordinates to resolve sharp changes.
Enforce initial and limiting values using the Theory of Functional Connections, and ensure Taylor-microscale growth through a realizability module.
evidence_signal: For decaying homogeneous isotropic turbulence using experimental and DNS trajectories, ten-seed tests show about 95% lower RMS seed-to-seed closure variation than an unconstrained model across training and held-out ranges.
watch_item: Validation is limited to decaying homogeneous isotropic turbulence; transfer to more complex flows remains unestablished.
paper_title: Construction of a Deployable Hard-Constrained Turbulence Closure
